name: Nasha Stall: Deep-Rooted Traditions
description: A Liyue-style market stall commonly seen in Nasha Town, from which the gentle fragrance of tea occasionally drifts.\nThough the stallholder initially planned to sell only tea leaves, Nasha Town's residents proved far more drawn to Liyue's ancient culture. To meet this local demand, the owner soon filled the shelves with various unique Liyue souvenirs for customers to browse.
